children.name: Streptococcus pneumoniae
children.description: Streptococcus pneumoniae, or pneumococcus, is a Gram-positive, spherical bacteria, alpha-hemolytic member of the genus Streptococcus.

children.name: Streptococcus pyogenes
children.description: Streptococcus pyogenes is a species of Gram-positive, aerotolerant bacteria in the genus Streptococcus.

children.name: Streptococcus agalactiae
children.description: Streptococcus agalactiae (also known as group B streptococcus or GBS) is a gram-positive coccus (round bacterium) with a tendency to form chains (as reflected by the genus name Streptococcus).

children.name: Streptococcus thermophilus
children.description: Streptococcus thermophilus, formerly known as Streptococcus salivarius subsp.

children.name: Streptococcus mutans
children.description: Streptococcus mutans is a facultatively anaerobic, gram-positive coccus (round bacterium) commonly found in the human oral cavity and is a significant contributor to tooth decay.

children.name: Streptococcus dysgalactiae
children.description: Streptococcus dysgalactiae is a gram positive, beta-haemolytic, coccal bacterium belonging to the family Streptococcaceae.

children.name: Streptococcus iniae
children.description: Streptococcus iniae is a species of Gram-positive, sphere-shaped bacterium belonging to the genus Streptococcus.

children.name: Streptococcus canis
children.description: Streptococcus canis is a group G beta-hemolytic species of Streptococcus.
